To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
German companies are still in their infancy of internationalizing their online presence and are not yet able to adapt their websites to the cultural values of their target markets.

German companies do not adapt to the cultural environment in their cross border websites, but they are not totally alien to it either, and that there is a need for further research on cultural adaptation in cross border e-commerce, especially for European companies.
the cultural values are not well represented on websites of the 100 German companies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how companies should adapt to cultural values in the context of online communication and commerce.
cultural value depiction and cultural adaptation on websites.
the question how German firms adapt their online presence to different cultural settings.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no clear answer as to the standardization vs. the adaptation question.
cultural adaptation in online communication and commerce is still in its infancy.
cultural values are not very strong on the Internet and that companies should work harder to achieve better cultural congruence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cultural congruency in the digital world is not a given.
companies should consider cultural values in their online communication and commerce efforts, but that they do not need to go to extremes in order to be culturally congruent.

cultural value depiction on the websites of German companies is not very strong, and therefore the companies need to work more on adapting their websites in order to reach a higher cultural congruency with their target markets.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cultural values are important and need to be taken into consideration in the online environment as well as in traditional communication.
companies need to be aware of the cultural implications of their online presence, and to be able to engage with customers on a cultural level.
companies should not only focus on cultural adaptation but also on the cultural congruency of their websites.
